subject: Invoice reissue request — Summit Labs entity consolidation
messages:
From: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@summit-labs.eu>

Cc: finance@summit-labs.eu
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:17:00 +0200
Subject: Invoice reissue request — Summit Labs legal entity consolidation

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note from Summit Labs Finance — we completed our internal consolidation last week and invoices for services rendered from Jan–May 2027 need to be reissued under our new legal entity: Summit Labs Holdings B.V. (VAT: NL819012345B01). Attached is our EU VAT registration certificate and the signed entity-change cover sheet.

Specifically we need:
- Reissued invoices for invoice numbers: 2027-000112, 2027-000137, 2027-000145 (Jan–May run)
- New bill-to and legal name on invoice PDF: Summit Labs Holdings B.V.
- VAT number displayed on each invoice and VAT line item broken out where applicable
- Please send reissued invoices to finance@summit-labs.eu and cc: m.rossi@summit-labs.eu

Bank details remain the same — we will notify you if that changes. We also attached the signed change request (EntityChange_Signed.pdf) and the VATRegistration.pdf for your records.

Do you need a PO or any other paperwork? Our AP is on a tight month-end (end of June) so an ETA would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Petrova
Head of Finance, Summit Labs
attachments: VATRegistration.pdf (pdf), EntityChange_Signed.pdf (pdf)

Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:05:00 +02:00

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the consolidation. I copied Marcus (your account lead) and Laura (billing ops) to coordinate.

Quick questions so we can scope the work and ETA:
- Can you confirm the PO number you want on the reissued invoices (if any)?
- Are the bank details and payment terms unchanged (net-30) for AP?
- Do you want us to void the original invoices and issue credit memos first, or create replacement invoices with a new numbering suffix?

I'll attach our internal billing form so Laura has all the metadata she needs. Plan is to triage this today and provide an estimated completion date by EOD.

Best,
Jasmine Liu

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the quick reply.

PO: PL-2027-06-771 (please include on all reissued docs)
Payment terms: unchanged, net-30 from invoice date.
Bank details: unchanged.

We prefer credit memos to avoid duplicate payments on our side (i.e., void originals + issue credits + reissued invoices). AP also requests a short reference on each reissued invoice with the original invoice number in parentheses.

I've attached the signed entity-change confirmation and a scanned copy of the VAT cert. Here's the DocuSign trace as well: https://www.docusign.com/summary/abcdef1234567890

Let me know if you need the company registration extract or notarized docs — I'll escalate internally. We need the reissued PDFs by Friday 18 Jun to meet our accounts payable run.

Best,
Elena
attachments: EntityChange_Signed.pdf (pdf), VATRegistration.pdf (pdf)

Jasmine/Laura — thanks for looping me in. Short internal plan:
1) Billing will void the three original invoices and post credit memos referencing the originals.
2) Accounting will generate three reissued invoices under "Summit Labs Holdings B.V." with PO PL-2027-06-771 and include original invoice reference in the footer.
3) Make sure VAT registration number and legal name are present on header and the VAT line is visible.
4) Add client-requested invoice numbering suffix: "-SLH-BV" to help Summit AP match entries (e.g., 2027-000112-SLH-BV).

Laura — can you confirm whether we need any internal GL/cost center mapping for the reissued docs? If so, include that mapping in the credit memo file so we don't create reconciliation churn for the customer.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Verify attachments (VAT cert + signed change) against the client portal entry — done by EOD Thu 17 Jun.

- Generate new invoices with suffix "-SLH-BV" and PO PL-2027-06-771 (target delivery: 18 Jun 2027 before 14:00 CET).
- Add line in each invoice footer: "Original invoice: <number> — Reissued for legal entity consolidation."
